definition: `PriorSimply y x`: y is prior to x simply, not in time: whatever is in potency in a respect presupposes some being in act in that respect, because potency is reduced to act only by a being in act. It is a dependence relation distinct from present moving. Whether simple priority makes y a cause of x's being is not part of this definition: that is the open premise STMT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-IS-CAUSE-OF-BEING. In Lean PriorSimply is a primitive relation with no body: the gloss above is carried only by the premise ActSimplyPriorToPotencyReading (a constraining premise, not the linked relation projection), which constrains it; it is not a definitional equation.
note: Primitive boundary: the linked declaration projects an independently supplied binary relation on beings from PriorityFrame Being Respect; it is not a definition by temporal, causal or perfection data.
